notes.title: The game release is coming soon!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Today I've got an excellent news - Smile To Fly is going to be released from the Early Access this week! 
The release will be supplied with huge update which will add a tower-defence elements with new buildings and new opportunities!
So these days is your last chance to get Smile To Fly with lower price, because soon the price will be raised up.
And while the last preparations is in progress I would like to present you a small screenshot of new tower defence facilities. Thank you for your support and stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35894867/e581432889f13007ae4e42001b707e17d9f6c880.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update to version 0.3.1
notes.notes:
Hello! I am glad to present you our first regular update with new improvements, bug fixes and some additional content. Live version now is 0.3.1
Change log:

Improvements and chages:
1. New minigame added: fly on rocket and gather bonuses :)
2. Added sound volume setting (separately of music setting)
3. UI small changes.

Bug fixes:
1. Upgrade buildings bug fixed.
2. Problems with some buidlings prices fixed.
3. Small visual bugs fixed.
4. Other small technical improvements.

Thank you and have a nice day! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35894867/e9e083bca2a12b3e7a5cd2e3c2b5e87f65c6b658.png[/img]

notes.title: Small Patch Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Decided to tell you more about bunch of recent small updates, which were caused by first impressions of players who already tried our Early Access version.
So here is a changelog:

1. Resources income was rebalanced: now electricity and gold mining work more effectively.
2. Some of the achievments was deleted. Soon they will be replaced by another.
3. Small bug fixes and technical improves.

Thank you and stay tuned - our first huge update is coming soon!
